name: @djgrant/freeagent/contacts-and-outstanding
description: Reads FreeAgent contacts and open or overdue invoices and bills, linking outstanding debtor and creditor amounts to their contacts for opening-balance audit work.

needs_auth.hint: Sign in to your FreeAgent account, then retry.

reads: FreeAgent contacts and open or overdue invoices and bills

($org := $trim($exists($c.organisation_name) ? $c.organisation_name : ''); $person := $trim(($exists($c.first_name) ? $c.first_name : '') & ' ' & ($exists($c.last_name) ? $c.last_name : '')); $org != '' ? $number(due_value) : $total - $paid; $c := $contactData.contacts[url = $contactUrl][0]; { 'bill_id': $id(url), 'contact_id': $id(contact), 'contact_name': $contactName($c), 'reference': $exists(reference) ? reference : '', 'dated_on': $exists(dated_on) ? dated_on : '', 'due_on': $exists(due_on) ? due_on : '', 'status': $exists(status) ? status : '', 'currency': $exists(currency) ? currency : 'GBP', 'total': $total, 'paid': $paid, 'outstanding': $due, 'url': url })[$.outstanding != 0]]; {'contacts': $contacts, 'debtors': $debtors, 'creditors': $creditors, 'total_debtors': $sum($debtors.outstanding) ?
